title: PNPD Product Delivery Artifact Registry Schema
description: Advisory-only, local-only, read-only registry of Product Delivery artifact metadata. The registry records what exists; it does not authorize implementation, merge, dispatch, deployment, GitHub/API mutation, release, or production readiness. Owner remains final human authority. Codex is auditor/reviewer, not Owner. AgentBridge has no authority to approve, merge, deploy, certify, or dispatch.

recordType.description: Identifies this as a Product Delivery artifact registry.

registryId.description: Unique identifier for this registry instance.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this registry was created.

governance.description: Governance constraints for this registry. All authorizing fields are locked to false.

entries.description: Ordered list of Product Delivery artifact entries in this registry.

repo.description: Repository metadata. rootRelative is always '.' because the registry lives in the repo root.

rootRelative.description: Registry root is always relative to the repository root.

branch.description: Current branch name when the registry was created or updated.

commit.description: Full 40-character Git commit hash at registry creation or update time.

governance.description: Locked governance constraints. All authorizing fields are false. Owner remains final human authority. Codex is auditor/reviewer, not Owner.

authorizesGitHubMutation.description: Registry does not authorize GitHub API mutation.

authorizesApiMutation.description: Registry does not authorize any API mutation.

certifiesProductionReadiness.description: Registry does not certify production readiness.

ownerFinalAuthority.description: Owner remains final human authority for all decisions.

runtimeConsumptionAllowed.description: Runtime/orchestrator must not consume registry data.

artifactGenerationAllowed.description: Automated artifact generation is not allowed.

externalMutationAllowed.description: External mutation (network, API, filesystem write) is not allowed.

entry.description: A single Product Delivery artifact entry in the registry.

artifactId.description: Unique identifier for this artifact entry.

artifactType.description: Machine-validated Product Delivery artifact type. Only these four types have schemas, fixtures, and validators.

phase.description: Development phase this artifact belongs to (e.g., Phase 1N).

path.description: Repo-relative path to the artifact JSON file. Rejects leading /, .. traversal, URL schemes, ~, .env, Windows drive prefixes, .pnpd/ prefix, and non-.json extensions. Symlink realpath containment is enforced by the validator at validation time.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was created.

integrity.description: Content integrity evidence for the referenced artifact file.

validation.description: Structured validation evidence. Does not include raw shell command strings. Semantic rules (validatedAt, exitCode expectations) are enforced by the Phase 1O-D validator.

mode.description: Validation mode. Always the standalone artifact mode.

status.description: Validation status. valid: artifact passed standalone validation. invalid: artifact failed validation. notValidated: no validation run recorded. stale: artifact changed after validation or timestamp no longer trusted. unknown: legacy/imported entry without enough evidence.

validatedAt.description: Timestamp of last validation run, or null if never validated.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the validated artifact file.

exitCode.description: Exit code from the most recent validation run. 0 = passed, 1 = failed. Optional; not required.

source.description: Provenance information for the artifact. Does not include approval or certification source types.

sourceType.description: Origin of the artifact. ownerProvided: created by the human owner. deepseekGenerated: created by DeepSeek agent. humanAuthored: created by a human contributor. imported: imported from another system. unknown: provenance not recorded.

sourceRef.description: Reference or identifier for the source (e.g., thread ID, document path, contributor name).

integrity.description: Content integrity evidence. If hashAlgorithm is sha256, contentHash should be a 64-character hex string. If hashAlgorithm is none, contentHash should be null. Semantic rules enforced by future validator.

hashAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm used. sha256 for SHA-256, none when no hash is recorded.

contentHash.description: Content hash of the referenced artifact file, or null when hashAlgorithm is none.
